P-TEM-03.summary: The flagship appliance: AI-accelerated threat detection in a box, with a 7-inch touch screen.

sections.heading: Inside
items: IT7Q's carrier board with a Raspberry Pi compute module
A dedicated AI accelerator for spotting threats in real time

sections.heading: The range
paragraphs: The TEMPESTAS range runs on IT7Q's own carrier board, built around a Raspberry Pi compute module, with AI-accelerated threat detection on the higher tiers. Five tiers, priced from $149 to $1,499.
